story.text: Then comes the {PROCESSION}: soldiers, courtiers, the royal {CHILDREN}, the White Rabbit, and last of all the {KING} and Queen of {HEARTS}. When Alice answers boldly, the Queen turns crimson with {FURY} and screams, “Off with her {HEAD}!” “Nonsense!” says Alice, very loudly, and the Queen is {SILENT}.
story.caption: The Queen has come!
story.credit: John Tenniel, coloured for The Nursery “Alice”, 1890
